ideas.title: Minnesota Officials Right About FBI
ideas.description: This story would investigate allegations that Minnesota officials were correct in their concerns about FBI actions, potentially leading to a deeper examination of FBI wrongdoing in the state.
ideas.angle: Examining the relationship between Minnesota officials and the FBI
questions: What were the concerns of Minnesota officials?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover significant wrongdoing by the FBI and shed light on the relationship between federal and state officials.

ideas.title: Child Care Funding Freeze
ideas.description: This story would investigate the Trump administration's attempt to freeze $10B in child care funding for blue-state families, potentially leading to a deeper examination of the motivations behind this move and its impacts on vulnerable populations.
ideas.angle: Examining the Trump administration's actions on child care funding
questions: What were the motivations behind the funding freeze?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover significant wrongdoing by the Trump administration and shed light on the impacts of their actions on vulnerable populations.
